name: AI Checklist
description: Checklist API-driven setup/configuration checklist for the AI module stack (DXPR CMS oriented); auto-detects installed modules.
project_description:
This module is part of the AI module ecosystem and included in DXPR CMS .

 Stop guessing which AI modules you need. AI Checklist creates a structured to-do list that eliminates setup confusion and guides you through AI implementation step-by-step.

 
 It breaks AI implementation down into logical sections like Initial Setup, AI Images, AI Content, and Supporting Tools. Each task includes download links and direct access to configuration screens.

 AI Checklist also keeps track of what has already been completed. It automatically detects installed modules and allows you

 to save your progress with timestamps. This provides a simple report that you can share with others showing implementation

 progress.

 You need AI Checklist if 
 
 You're implementing AI features in Drupal for the first time. 
 You work on multiple Drupal sites and need to track AI setup progress. 
 You want a systematic approach to AI module configuration. 
 You prefer organized checklists when tackling complex implementations. 
 
 Back to top 

 AI Checklist does not : 
 
 Provide AI strategy or content recommendations. 
 Install or configure modules automatically. 
 Generate AI content or analysis. 
 Replace the need to understand individual AI modules. 
 
 AI Checklist is designed to be a helpful guide, not a magic solution - it organizes the journey but you still

 need to walk the path.
